- **Name and address.** After the values are restored, combine the three name parts into the single B06 field in the order shown. If the restored Singapore address includes the postcode, copy it into the separate postcode field in both B08 and B18. If B07 requires a particular date format, reformat the restored date on your device.
- **Employment.** Your Brisbane nursing job starts on **1 February 2027**. B11–B14 still need the applicable employer details, formal job title, employment length and gross weekly income. If you use the upcoming job to support the application, label it as upcoming and include the start date.
- **Property manager or owner.** They specify the submission methods, requested documents and premises rules about pets. You have a Philippine passport available if they request it for identity verification.
- **Remaining applicant details.** Add your email, the flat’s full address and postcode, your Singapore landlord or property manager’s contact details, and details for two referees. Complete B21 if you have a second rental to list.
